artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: Source only; no deploy is in this cell's scope. S04: normalizes/dedupes full account identities (AC1-AC4), reconciles the expected population against synthetic 0833 custodian records (EXACT_MATCH/MASTER_CONFLICT/STRATEGY_CONFLICT/MISSING_CUSTODIAN, AC5-AC8, AC10), discovers UNCONFIRMED Tax-labelled candidates outside the expected set (AC9), checks the 0824 base-population overlap (BASE_OVERLAP/BASE_OVERLAP_UNVERIFIED, AC11-AC12), annotates BD technical enrollment on its own axis (AC13), and never returns or logs a full account key from its reconciliation-reporting surface (AC14).

15 tests (test_ac1_ .. test_ac14_, one per criterion, plus one structural forbidden-call-site test); synthetic account keys only (minted through _key(), recorded into ALL_RAW_KEYS for the AC14 leak scan). No live route, Microsoft Graph, SharePoint or BD roster call in this suite. py -3.12 -m pytest ... -q: 15 passed in 0.10s.

The probe for all 14 criteria: each AC runs its named pytest subset in a fresh subprocess (never in-process), requires rc 0 AND at least one test collected (a 0-of-0 run is a refused vacuous pass), and prints exactly one VERDICT line. Mirrors the TX-m-1 probe's structure (same repo, same pattern).
This order's result record: every value with its instrument, UTC time and denominator; it rides the commit that carries this instance.
